crossRefs.note: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness…
In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

translations.web: After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
translations.bsb: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
translations.kjv: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
translations.asv: And after all this Jehovah smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
